planets.name: HD 332231 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 332231 with a 18.7-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HD 332231 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 332231. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
